Definition: to waver, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined)
BiblicalUsage: Nua means to waver, to shake, to wander. God tells Cain in Genesis 4:12 that he will be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth, and at Sinai the people see the thunderings and the mountain smoking, and they remove and stand afar off in Exodus 20:18.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that sin makes a man unsteady, and the fear of God makes a people stand back, but only grace brings either of them near.
RelatedEvents: Cain Murders Abel; The Ten Commandments
